_comment: Documentation snapshot of the applied branch protection for `main`. The GitHub protection API rejects non-schema fields, so strip them on replay: jq 'del(.["$schema"], ._comment, ._status, .required_signatures)' .github/branch-protection.json | gh api -X PUT repos/netresearch/glpi-docker-compose-stack/branches/main/protection --input - ; then enable signed commits separately: gh api -X POST repos/netresearch/glpi-docker-compose-stack/branches/main/protection/required_signatures
_status: Applied 2026-06-28. Required status checks use the real job-level check-run names (not workflow names). scorecard is NOT a required PR check — it runs on push-to-main + weekly schedule, never on PRs, so requiring it would block every PR.
